FAQ

Good to know

Is the quote really free?

Yes. Tell us about your job and we'll give you a free quote.

How often can you cut my grass?

We offer a 2 or 4 week grass cutting service.

Do you offer same-day service?

Yes, same-day service is available. Call or text to check availability.

Do you work on businesses as well as homes?

Yes. We cover residential and commercial properties.

How do I pay?

PayPal or bank transfer.

What if my job isn't listed?

We do many other jobs not listed. Send an enquiry and ask.
